## Documentation

A restriction applied to bots or chats.

### Parameters

- **`platform`** (`str`)
  The platform the restriction is applied to, e.g. "ios", "android"

- **`reason`** (`str`)
  The restriction reason, e.g. "porn", "copyright".

- **`text`** (`str`)
  The restriction text.
